messages:
joe: AcmeCorp wants SIEM ingestion + admin audit trail evidence for POC. They need sample logs, retention policy, and confirmation of admin activity logging. Can we get this to them by EOW (Fri)?

irene: I can own sample logs. What output formats do they accept? Splunk HEC, Azure Monitor, S3? :thinking:

sam: For Hosted: we retain operational audit logs (control-plane events like key changes, model deploy, user invites) 90 days by default. Request/response payloads are not persisted beyond 30 days unless debug mode is enabled and customer opts in. For Dedicated/Private, retention is configurable and can be exported to customer SIEM.

miranda: They said they need 12 months retention for admin trails and real-time SIEM forwarding. For Dedicated, we can forward to syslog/HEC or push to an S3 bucket with lifecycle. For Hosted, we can set up a delivery job to push logs to customer's S3 (via presigned upload) for the POC — entitlements team needs sign-off.

sam: Important: we redact user-provided content in logs by default. Admin activity logs (who changed roles, created keys, initiated rolls) are full-fidelity and include actor, action, timestamp, request_id, and resource. All logs are encrypted at rest with KMS.

danny: Do we capture API-level request IDs and model response token counts? Customer wants token usage per request for cost reconciliation.

irene: Yes — logs include request_id, client_id (hashed), model, prompt_token_count, completion_token_count, total_tokens, latency_ms, and status_code. Example event:

```
{"timestamp":"2026-02-25T14:12:03Z","request_id":"req_01F...","client_id":"cid_***","model":"redwood/fast-7b","event":"generation_complete","prompt_tokens":45,"completion_tokens":120,"total_tokens":165,"latency_ms":312,"status":200}
```

miranda: For admin events sample:

```
2026-02-25T14:13:12Z | actor: alice@acme.com | action: grant_role | target: project-42 | request_id: admin_0a1b | region: us-west-2
```

sec-review-bot: [AUTO] Generated SIEM export checklist: https://redwood.internal/sec/siem-export-checklist (internal) :white_check_mark:

joe: Great. Action items: 1) Irene to drop a zipped sample S3 export (incl. request logs + admin events) by Thu EOD. 2) Sam to confirm Hosted retention numbers + redact policy in an email to legal. 3) Miranda to confirm syslog/HEC forwarding config and whether we can do near real-time for the POC. 4) Danny to prepare a short note explaining token fields for cost reconciliation.

irene: I'll upload sample to a presigned S3 link and DM the customer. Ping me if we need additional fields.

sam: Will send legal note and attach SOC2 control mapping for logging.

miranda: Blocking: entitlements needed to enable S3 export for prod SaaS tenant — I'll open ticket with eng-ops.

joe: Thanks team. If we hit any blockers, flag here. :rocket:
